tools.toktx: 'toktx' is not recognized as an internal or external command, operable program or batch file.

tone_mapping.live: THREE.AgXToneMapping + Blender's 'Medium High Contrast' look patched into three's AgX (AgX-log contrast 1.2 about pivot 0.606, a CALIBRATED value = AgX-log mid-grey, not OCIO's 0.4; viewer override ?piv=, before the sigmoid), toneMappingExposure 1, outputColorSpace SRGB (applied once, in OutputPass)
tone_mapping.cycles: AgX, look 'Medium High Contrast', exposure 0, gamma 1 (the stills)
tone_mapping.note: pivot: OCIO's log pivot (-0.2 -> 0.4) brightened live by +18 luma vs the stills, mid-grey matches them (thirds within 1-8); the GLB emissive strengths / site light were calibrated by luma against the Cycles stills under these settings

render.environment: v022 studio (scene extras.studio; there is no extras.sky, no CITY_card, no fog): scene.environment = PMREMGenerator.fromScene(a scene holding copies of extras.studio.room and every extras.studio.env_only node at their world matrices, plus, at night, the extras.studio.night_glow sphere; near 1, far 3000, position extras.studio.env_position). scene.background = null: the room mesh is the visible background (clear colour #d8d8d6 day / #1b2130 night). env_only nodes and the glow sphere are NEVER drawn in the main view. Never a flat colour. (v020 / v021: extras.sky -> float equirect.)

studio.note: v022 studio maquette (owner 2026-10-25), mode = extras.studio.mode. day (v022): white daylight studio, bloom off, window / lobby emission a daytime glimmer. night (v022n, the owner-adopted release): the studio dimmed cool; extras.studio.moon = one THREE.DirectionalLight(color, intensity) along direction_to_light (Cycles light-links it to the model only: the lightmapped room / plinth / site have black base colour, so it cannot light them twice); extras.studio.night_glow = an env-only inward sphere, unlit colour = color x gain x mix(min, 1, smoothstep(height_from, height_to, y)), the dark-navy sheen of the glass; bloom = extras.studio.bloom on tower.glb, off on tower-lite.glb. Both: renderer.toneMappingExposure = 2 ** extras.studio.exposure_stops; extras.turntable: rotate the root node (it carries ARCH_*, SITE, SYS_*, plinth) about +Y while idle, ease back to 0 before a system entry; camera_limits.hero_shift_y replaces the hard-coded 0.227. Full schema: extras-schema.md.

city.note: v022 city attempt (superseded by the studio maquette; kept for reference): the Cycles stills had a full procedural city; the GLB carried a light backdrop only
city.CITY_card: 700 m cylinder round PIVOT_hero, KHR_materials_unlit, alphaMode BLEND, tex_city_band (4096 x 512 full / 2048 x 256 lite: 360 deg x latitude -20..+15 deg), baked from the stills city beyond 235 m
city.CITY_ring: 34 low blocks at 150-228 m, one instanced unit box (EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing), unlit, tex_city_ring toned from the band
city.SITE_ground: radius 240 m, MAT_ground_live: unlit, alpha BLEND, tex_city_ground (1024 full / 512 lite) = a top-down Cycles render of the stills city ground (streets, lamp pools, cars, tree canopies), alpha fades 205 -> 240 m

bloom.pass: UnrealBloomPass on a HalfFloat, 4x MSAA EffectComposer target, before OutputPass
bloom.note: linear HDR threshold above the lit office windows: only the light sources (crown LED line, lamps, lobby, uplit pilaster bases, trails) bloom

interior_mapping.grid: 64 x 24 modules over the emissive UV (1.2 x 3.6 m; v runs down the facade)
interior_mapping.note: ray traced into an open-plan room per fragment, hit mapped back onto the band of tex_cw_emit (onBeforeCompile on emissivemap_fragment); lite keeps the baked room picture (ceiling-panel perspective = the depth cue)
